items.question: What is the chemical name of common table salt?
items.explanation: Table salt is sodium chloride, with the formula NaCl. It is made of sodium and chlorine. Sodium bicarbonate is baking soda, a different substance.

items.question: Sugar dissolving in water is a physical change.
items.explanation: When sugar dissolves, it spreads out in the water but stays sugar. No new substance is made. If you let the water evaporate, the sugar is left behind again.

items.question: Baking soda helps cakes rise when heated. Which gas does it give off?
items.explanation: When baking soda (sodium hydrogencarbonate) is heated, it releases carbon dioxide gas. The gas makes tiny bubbles in the batter, so the cake becomes soft and spongy.

items.fact: Vinegar is a weak solution of acetic acid in water — about 5 to 8 percent acid.
items.explanation: Acetic acid is also called ethanoic acid. It gives vinegar its sour taste and strong smell. Because it is an acid, vinegar is used to preserve pickles.

items.question: Cut apples turn brown after some time. What mainly causes this?
options: Substances in the apple react with oxygen in the air
The apple loses all its water
items.explanation: Cutting an apple lets air reach its inside. Natural substances in the fruit react with oxygen, which makes brown colours. A little lemon juice slows this down.
